title: Save a Turo car search to an n8n data table

actor.name: turo-car-scraper
actor.pricing_summary: Pay per event. On 2026-10-27 the active schedule started 2026-10-15. FREE-plan prices: actor start $0.00005 per GB (minimum one), car $0.0015, availability $0.0009. Details, host, and review events stay off in these templates. A replacement schedule starts 2026-10-31.

validation.evidence_summary: Imported from the portable workflow into n8n 2.1.4. Fixture tests covered invalid input, empty results, failed, aborted, timed-out, rejected and ambiguous starts, polling, and 12-row pagination. A second import repeated the 12-row result. A live San Francisco run with maxItems 2 stored 2 cars and reported usageTotalUsd 0.00393.
